chevron-right: Primitive: a 90-degree chevron on the 24 grid with a 2-unit stroke is the same in every set (also identical to the R1 built-in drawn for AbsoluteUI).
page-first: Primitive chevron with a bar at the 6-to-18 extent of the chevron family.
page-last: Primitive chevron with a bar at the 6-to-18 extent of the chevron family.
close: Primitive: two 12-unit diagonals through the centre.
arrow-left: Primitive: a shaft with a 90-degree head; head proportions follow the chevron family.
arrow-up-right: Primitive diagonal arrow: a 10-unit diagonal shaft with a 9-unit corner head.
circle: Primitive: a radius-9 circle, which matches any circular icon's ring.
spinner: Primitive: an open arc of a radius-9 circle; any loading arc on this grid overlaps another set's.
layout-columns: False positive: a frame with two vertical dividers matches the folds of Lucide's Map.
wifi: Conventional metaphor (dot and three concentric arcs); radii, spacing, and arc lengths are AbsoluteUI's own.
alert-triangle: Solid variant shares the warning-sign convention with Font Awesome's triangle-exclamation; corner radii and mark proportions differ.
alert-circle: False positive: the circle outline matches Lucide's History circle; the marks differ.
clock: Primitive: a radius-9 circle with two hands; the ring dominates the score (see circle). The match is a clock with a history arrow.
code: Primitive chevron pair (see chevron-right); any code mark built from two chevrons overlaps.
chart-bullet: Primitive: a rounded 18x8 bar; the match is an unrelated port shape sharing the rectangle.
target: Primitive: concentric rings (solid); the match is a crosshair sharing the rings.
text-input: Primitive: the rounded 19x12 field rectangle shared by every form-control icon; the match is a plain rectangle.
select: Primitive: the rounded field rectangle (see text-input); the match is an unrelated gamepad outline.
text-color: Convention: a letter A over a color bar is the established text-color mark in every editor.
